usage: Use 聽歌 when you mean listening to music or songs for enjoyment, especially in everyday conversation.
It is a very common spoken Cantonese phrase and sounds natural in casual, neutral register.
You can pair it with time words, places, or devices, for example when talking about commuting, relaxing, or using headphones.
Learners often use 聽歌 as a general listening habit; it does not imply studying music or paying attention to lyrics only.
